proposed_lessons: Proposed: do not recommend self-damage or an offensive setup when the post-action HP or unconfirmed enemy intent could make the line lethal; require exact enemy HP, Block, intent total, and card damage before calling a line lethal.

review.feedback: Before the next meaningful decision, read the VEDA inbox. Log current Act/floor/Ascension, HP, deck/relic/potion state, options, reasoning, recommendation, predicted result, actual outcome, and one or two evidence screenshots. Request review after each floor and critical events. For risky self-damage or claimed-lethal lines, require exact post-action HP, enemy HP, Block, intent, and damage; choose the safe line when uncertainty could leave HP at or below 15. Keep strategy changes proposed until evidence and a regression test validate them.
